blocks.title: Sequence diagram
blocks.text: Sequence diagrams show how objects in a system interact with each other in a particular order. They help in understanding the flow of messages between objects over time.

Figure 1.11 continues the room example. The user and three boxes (toys box, books box and clothes box) each have a vertical lifeline. The messages, read from top to bottom, are: open() each box; put the toys, books and clothes inside their boxes; then close() each box.

blocks.alt: Four lifelines, User, Toys Box, Books Box and Clothes Box, run down as dashed lines. Arrows go from User to the boxes in order: open() to each box, put toys inside, put books inside and put clothes inside, then close() to each box.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.11: Sequence diagram of the user organizing items into labeled boxes (original drawing after the textbook's Figure 1.11).
